summary:
FS.GG.Workspace.Template **0.20.1** (FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates) is published. Public installed acceptance exists for creations with `--no-coordination` (Wizard 0.23.0) and, since Wizard 0.23.1, for creations with default coordination. This supersedes the earlier owner-boundary record, which described the surface as eight configurations and seven selectors; the registry entry remains the schema authority for the full surface.

**Publication (2026-10-30):**
- Annotated tag `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1` (`ff5caa76`) peels to the register commit `df896c4b` (Templates#815).
- Release run 41042757474 succeeded: route, pack, the release-route gate (register accepted payload `7c48b222`, provider floor, composition lanes) and `publish [org-publication-writer]` under the ADR-0097 lock.
- Payload identity `7c48b222...` with 620 entries. Root read the GitHub Release asset and the nuget.org archive independently: the nuget.org archive carries the same 620 entries plus only `.signature.p7s`, so its sole difference is the signature. The GitHub Packages feed returned 403 to Root, so that feed rests on the workflow readback receipt (`payloadExact` true, 620 entries) plus the identical release asset.

**Surface:** the four CLI workspace providers `typescript-cli`, `javascript-cli`, `rust-cli` and `go-cli` (typed catalog `providers/polyglot.catalog.json`, digest `40dd5a8f...`), now with the common project-knowledge composition (guide, schema, CI workflow and checker). The published 0.20.0 payloads lack that composition.

**Public installed acceptance with `--no-coordination` (#3010 Step 3, comment 6523620705):** Wizard 0.23.0, SDD CLI 2.5.3 and Governance CLI 1.15.0 were installed from nuget.org only, with an isolated configuration and fresh cache. Each of the four providers was created through the public Wizard with `--no-coordination` against `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1`; each workspace's scaffold provenance pins the template sha and catalog `40dd5a8f`. Per provider: knowledge assets present, `doctor` coherent with no diagnostics, `knowledge check` and the generated checker after initialize, Governance Verify with all eight gates (build, lint, test, public-surface, package, security, evidence, release) and zero security findings. Five refusal controls (stale ref, bad digest in two variants, wrong policy, offline without pins, occupied target) exited nonzero on every provider, leaving the target byte-identical and no scratch. 85 of 85 checks passed after two retained harness-defect first runs (not product or tool defects). Receipts are in private custody; manifest digest `ea322f15...` and run summary `aa01a492...`.

**Default-coordination defect, fixed in Wizard 0.23.1 (comments 6523944130 and 6528086634):** Wizard 0.23.0 wrote `securityObligations` into the SDD-owned `.fsgg/scaffold-provenance.json`, which SDD 2.5.3's strict schema rejects, so `doctor.isCoherent` was `false` (`scaffold.provenanceMalformed`) on all four providers with default coordination; its coordination kit was also fetched from the moving `main` ref. Wizard 0.23.1 (published 2026-10-30, tag `new-sdd-workspace/v0.23.1` -> `e922a7c6`; .github#4964) keeps the obligations in Wizard-owned `.fsgg/security-obligations.json`, migrates 0.23.0 workspaces and pins the kit to `a9a6f77f`. **Public installed acceptance with default coordination now exists** for the four CLI providers: Wizard 0.23.1 installed from nuget.org in the contained no-credential carrier created TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust and Go CLI workspaces against `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1`; `doctor.isCoherent:true` with no diagnostics on each, both obligations pending (never claimed satisfied), provenance free of the moved keys, kit byte-identical to the pin, idempotent `retrofit`, and the 0.23.0-created workspaces migrated to coherent. 82 of 82 checks, accepted by Root on .github#4964 (comment 6528912322); receipts manifest `2e6a4afb9703c95e507e7652523d1f5577658c1e01e0eeea63d21e5b07ce4a00` in private custody (the 0.23.0 defect observation with the old tool is retained as the control in the same run).

**Limits:**
- The GitHub Packages feed bytes were not read directly (403).
- No reproducibility pack was made.
- Independent advisory-input custody is owed: the scanner databases were fetched by the same provisioning.
- Only Linux x64 on one contained carrier was exercised (both acceptances).
- The Wizard V2 `productBoard` route was not re-qualified by the 0.23.1 acceptance.

**Registry:** `registry/dependencies.yml` at the cited .github revision records version and package-version 0.20.1 (reconciled in .github#4955); a registry declaration is not feed or installed evidence on its own. Acceptance of 0.20.0 and earlier payloads remains historical at its original scope.
title: fs-gg-workspace-template 0.20.1: four CLI providers published; installed acceptance with and without coordination (Wizard 0.23.0 / 0.23.1)
